references.text: The Lord is my strength and my song; he has become my salvation. He is my God, and I will praise him.
To you our fathers put their trust; they relied on you, and you delivered them.
They forgot God, their Savior, who had done great things in Egypt, wonders in the land of Ham, and awesome deeds by the Red Sea.
Generation after generation shall praise your works and tell of your mighty acts. They shall speak of the splendor of your glory, and I will sing of your wonders.
Has any god ever tried to take for himself one nation out of another nation, by testings, by signs and wonders, by war, by a strong hand and an outstretched arm, or by great and awesome deeds?
The great trials you saw with your own eyes, the signs and wonders, the strong hand and the outstretched arm with which the Lord your God brought you out.
You have seen with your own eyes all that the Lord did in Egypt to Pharaoh and all his servants and all his land—the great trials your eyes witnessed.
The Lord is my song, for he is the one who heals and saves Israel.
Your righteousness, O God, reaches to the heavens. You have done great things. Who is like you, O God?
Let us then through him continually offer up a sacrifice of praise to God, that is, the fruit of lips that acknowledge his name.
